newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: P.Morris, Wills case hearing on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: P.Morris, Wills case hearing on Wednesday.

text.p: U.S. cigarette manufacturer Philip Morris Inc's Australian subsidiary will meet its Australian competitor W.D. & H.O. Wills in court on Wednesday for a directions hearing to contest allegations of misleading and deceptive conduct, a Philip Morris spokeswoman said on Monday.

Earlier on Monday, Wills said it had launched Federal Court proceedings against Philip Morris for 'passing off' Wills' value cigarette brand Horizon by planning to launch a brand packaged almost identically in terms of colour, lettering and imagery.
"We have considered the material provided (by Wills) and have briefed our laywers," Philip Morris Australia's corporate affairs manager, Nerida White, told Reuters.
Wills, 67 percent owned by B.A.T. Industries Plc, said Horizon had been the fastest growing cigarette brand in the Australian market with a 14 percent market share.
"We will use every available means to protect Horizon from attack by this me-too product," Wills corporate communicaitons manager Catherine Byrne said in a statement.
